# Find the cause before the capacity

`customer_support.pb.queue_management.find_the_cause_before_the_capacity` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> When volume spikes, spend the first stretch of the response on why it rose, not on absorbing it.

Support volume rarely rises because the world changed; it rises because we changed something — a release, a pricing email, a broken form, a status page nobody updated. Fixed at the cause it costs one action; absorbed in the queue it costs every ticket.
